title: IV fluid tonicity

findings.where: Images 1–4 and 8–11: hypotonic panel, dashed starting-size ring; tonicity.jsx Panel()
findings.title: Swollen cell obscures its starting-size reference
findings.problem: The dashed reference ring is drawn before the swollen cell, so the cell's translucent gradient paints over it. Source-color compositing puts the resulting contrast at roughly 2–2.5:1 in both themes, below even the 3:1 minimum for meaningful graphics. This weakens the before/after size comparison the legend explicitly asks students to use.
findings.fix: Draw the reference ring above the cell rather than beneath its fill. Use a contrast-tested stroke or halo that remains distinct against the cell gradient in both themes, and test the rendered comparison at phone width.

assessment: No clinical blocker identified in the tonicity content. The hypotonic cell-size comparison has a contrast defect.
